blocks.label: Intro
blocks.description: The site's one sentence, set large, with a line beneath and up to two buttons; optionally beside a round portrait. First on a page.

blocks.label: Lead post
blocks.description: The lead post with a large photograph, and the next few as titles beside or below it. Picks the newest featured post unless one is named.

blocks.label: Posts
blocks.description: The latest posts, or those under one tag, as rows, cards or an index of titles by year.

blocks.label: Topics
blocks.description: Every topic the posts use, with counts. Nothing to set up: it comes from the posts' tags.

blocks.label: Series
blocks.description: The series, each with its picture, line and parts in order.

blocks.label: Author
blocks.description: One author, large: portrait, role, name and bio, with a link to their posts.

blocks.label: Newsletter
blocks.description: The sign-up form (src/content/forms/newsletter.json) beside a heading; sends to the Galley inbox.

blocks.label: Text
blocks.description: Writing in Markdown, in the reading column or with its heading in the margin.

blocks.label: Photograph
blocks.description: One photograph with a caption: in the reading column, across the page or edge to edge.

blocks.label: Invitation
blocks.description: A heading, a line and one or two buttons, to close a page.

blocks.label: Contact
blocks.description: Ways to get in touch beside the contact form (src/content/forms/contact.json).

blocks.label: Chart
blocks.description: Lines, areas, columns, bars or stacked columns from a few numbers, with the numbers in a table beneath. Same as ```chart in a post.

blocks.label: Comparison table
blocks.description: Options across the top, what they're compared on down the side; yes/no/partly become marks and one column can be picked out.

blocks.label: Figures
blocks.description: Two to four figures set large, each with what it counts and how it moved.

blocks.label: Timeline
blocks.description: Dated events in order, on a line.

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.description: Questions that open one at a time; answers in Markdown.

blocks.label: Pull quote
blocks.description: One line set large in italic, with a name.

blocks.label: Gallery
blocks.description: Photographs in a grid of two to four columns, each with a caption.

templates.label: Post
templates.description: A post with a cover, "In short", a chart, a callout and sources — the shape most posts take.

templates.label: Review or comparison
templates.description: Weighing up options: a comparison table, a fifteen-year chart and a verdict with a score.

templates.label: About page
templates.description: Who writes the blog and why: an intro, a photograph, the story, figures, a timeline and questions.

templates.label: Topic landing page
templates.description: An intro, the lead post on one topic, the rest of its posts and a sign-up.
